findings.title: Legacy donor scan confused updater-container file offsets with CPU CODE offsets
findings.status: Corrected with explicit layout, vector anchors, and separate CPU/file offsets
evidence: All nine supplied updater containers are 0x10600 bytes
CODE begins at file 0x400 and OEM at 0x10400
The old raw[:65536] scan was shifted by 0x400 when treated as CPU CODE
